name: Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd.
summary: Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells products in the human life and industry sectors in Japan, the Czech Republic, Germany, rest of Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers ESLEN beads, ESLEN sheets, ESLEN wood, INTERFOAM, TECHEATER, returnable and food container, ESLEN cup, fruits/vegetable trays, thermal cover, ESLEN block, lightweight rooftop greening method, AQUAROAD, FJ-ring, thermal insulation materials for housing equipment, lightweight interior/exterior decoration, ESLEN TYK FORM, and other foamed/molded products for use in agricultural and marine product containers, food containers, distribution materials, construction materials, and civil engineering …
